description:
The ctrl+o functionality could not be tested in tmux as the ctrl+o (Shift+O, ASCII 0x0F) key combination is intercepted by tmux's own key handling before reaching the terminal application.

OBSERVED:
- tmux capture shows the literal text 'co' being entered when ctrl+o is attempted
- The ctrl+o functionality cannot be tested via tmux send-keys

WORKAROUND:
This functionality should be tested in a direct terminal (not via tmux) to verify the overlay menu appears correctly with loaded resources.

EXPECTED BEHAVIOR (from Node.js documentation):
- Press ctrl+o shows an overlay with 'full startup help and loaded resources'
- Should display the same information as the initial startup banner in a dismissable overlay
title: TUI-13: ctrl+o overlay functionality cannot be tested in tmux
